summary.intent: Win the Lio 'Keep the Line Running' challenge at START Hack Munich: analyse Soony's launch data, then build an alert agent (watcher, versioned store, email, phone calls, push, voice assistant) that rechecks plans against documents and acts on problems.
summary.outcome: Found that Soony's plan says 'ok' while the Collector's Edition misses Sunday (art books, statues, game cards). Built a polling watcher, a Gmail mailer, Twilio and GPT-Realtime alert calls, and a PWA with push, cookie login and a voice assistant that can look up, send and escalate. Real verifier cards were installed in the inbox. Nothing from the night is pushed yet.

repo: Portal API has only /files, /files/{path} and /archive.zip, no webhooks; files are replaced under the same name, so change detection must compare SHA-256, not filenames.
Challenge data is confidential: keep it in gitignored data/, never commit or put values in code; also never print keys, tokens or full phone numbers.
CLAUDE.md rules: no em dashes, placeholders like example.com in tests, commit author josteng, no attribution trailers, commit per topic without asking, but ask before every push or PR.
Entire only writes a checkpoint when repo files changed in the session; 'no files modified, skipping checkpoint' is normal for read-only turns.

The ask-soony-serve tmux session runs code loaded from jonas/alerts; the working tree is on jonas/voice-dashboard (based on akshat/dashboard), which lacks the alerts and openai_calls code, so restarting serve from this checkout would break the call webhooks.
Akshat's dashboard only shows sample cards unless a module writes data/store/*cards*.json; origin/integration/verifier produces real cards with to_email.
BasicAuth middleware must read ASK_DASHBOARD_PASSWORD from the process env only, not .env, or Akshat's tests fail.
iOS home screen PWAs do not show the browser basic-auth dialog and do not keep that login, so a white 401 page appears; a cookie login page with 30-day expiry fixed it.
Manifest and service worker must be exempt from auth; a manifest link behind auth needs crossorigin='use-credentials'.
Twilio trial accepts only Url mode (not inline Twiml) and only verified numbers; German numbers need a business regulatory bundle, so a US number was used.

OpenAI Realtime over SIP needs a project-level webhook (realtime.call.incoming); background-noise handling needed server_vad threshold 0.8, near_field noise reduction, interrupt_response false and an instruction to ignore side conversations.

code.finding: Replaced the browser basic-auth dialog with a /login form and 30-day cookie, parsing the form body manually to avoid a multipart dependency; open redirects are blocked.

Voice tools get_card_details, send_supplier_email and escalate_to; sending only goes out for prewritten drafts, with explicit confirmation, to portal-profile supplier addresses, and not while a dashboard edit is pending.
Web Push via pywebpush with a VAPID P-256 key stored in data/state/; drops 404/410 subscriptions; /api/push/test returns 409 when no device is subscribed.

WebRTC GPT-Realtime call with ringing 'Incoming launch alert' view (?card=ID&talk=1), decision mapping approve to allow_once, reject to dismiss, escalate to edit; later got hold-to-talk, ordered transcript and English transcription.

workflow: Check the portal after every answer: five files dropped within 37 minutes without notice, which changed the findings (game cards short, Nowak's 24 h offer).
Use a subagent for bulk cross-checks (200 order confirmations and 59 scans) while continuing other work.
Confirm paid actions first: an auto-bought US Twilio number led to a correction, saved as the memory 'ask-before-spending'.
Persist state to memory before compaction, including branches, tmux services, tunnels and next steps, without secrets.
Read the server inbox log to debug phone-only problems when a device-side failure can't be seen directly.

friction: Twilio trial limits, KYC, and the German number regulation bundle blocked the originally planned number.
GitHub was unreachable overnight, so jonas/alerts and jonas/voice-dashboard are unpushed.
Calls failed for a while because the user's phone was on Do Not Disturb.
Realtime voice cut off or answered background chatter until VAD and noise settings were tuned.
iPhone PWA showed no permission dialog at first, then a white screen on reopen; the card details are hidden far down on mobile.
Sample cards used placeholder supplier addresses (example.com), so sending was refused until real verifier cards were installed.
The transcript rendered out of order, and the background voice was misrecognised as Chinese text, since transcription language was not set.
The wrong Cloudflare tunnel was used at first, QUIC was blocked, and second-level subdomain certificates failed.
A real alert email was sent to a personal address by mistake, which led to making alert emails opt-in.
open_items: Push jonas/alerts and jonas/voice-dashboard once GitHub is reachable (needs explicit OK) and tell Akshat about his edited files (api.py, App.tsx, Detail.tsx).
Test the PWA login, push and voice answer on a real iPhone.
Connect critical cards automatically to push and, on escalation, the Twilio call; today only the test button sends push.
Confirm who builds the 'sender' that reads decisions.json so mails are not sent twice.
Send the Karton Nowak art-book order (8,000 books, offer valid 24 h) via the product.
Switch to jonas/alerts or merge before restarting ask-soony-serve.
Possible UI improvements: scroll to details on tap, move 'Enable call alerts' to the top bar.
Prepare demo script, deck, video (≤3 min) and README for the Sunday 12:00 hand-in.
Delete the old Claude doc or keep both, still unanswered.
